hero.title: International
hero.subtitle: African Coffee Fair
hero.description: The second edition of the International African Coffee Fair will take place from November 18 to 20, 2026 in Montreal. An international event bringing together producers, roasters and investors to promote exceptional African coffees on the North American market.

about.title: About
about.description1: The International African Coffee Fair (SICAF) is an economic, commercial and cultural platform dedicated to promoting African coffee on international markets.
about.description2: Following the success of its first edition, SICAF returns for a second edition to be held from
about.preambleText1: Africa is recognized as the birthplace of coffee and remains one of the most important producing regions in the world. However, despite the exceptional quality of its coffees and the diversity of its terroirs, African producers still face several challenges related to access to international markets, local processing, financing and the valorization of their products.
about.preambleText2: In response to this observation, the
about.preambleText3: initiated the International African Coffee Fair to create a space for meeting, promotion and development of business opportunities between African and North American stakeholders.
about.goals: SICAF was born from the desire to:
goalsList: Promote the excellence of African coffee
Facilitate trade between Africa and Canada
Encourage investment in the coffee sector
Position African coffee as a reference product on international markets

ateliers.title: SICAF Workshops
ateliers.subtitle: Practical workshops designed to equip African coffee stakeholders and prepare them for export to the Canadian market

workshops.title: Strategic Workshop - Understanding the Canadian Market
workshops.objective: Decipher the dynamics of the coffee market in Canada to better position yourself.

workshops.title: Export Workshop - Logistics, Customs & Market Access
workshops.objective: Master the export process to Canada.
content: Go-to-market: how to build an exportable offer

workshops.title: Branding & Product Positioning Workshop
workshops.objective: Enhance your coffee to stand out in a competitive market.
content: Build an export brand (storytelling, visual, identity)
Packaging, storytelling, certifications: how to convince the buyer
workshops.audience: Producers, cooperatives, agro-export SMEs, local brands

workshops.title: Taste & Tasting Workshop - The Art of Cupping
workshops.objective: Master the sensory criteria valued in Canada.
content: Introduction to cupping and appreciated aromatic profiles

workshops.title: Technical Workshop - Cultivation, Processing & Sustainability
workshops.objective: Strengthen the quality and sustainability of the coffee value chain.
content: Good agricultural practices, post-harvest and fermentation
